findings.summary: build_features is called on the whole dataset before the train/test split, so scaling statistics include test rows and leak test data, inflating test AUC; fitted statistics are also never saved.

Mean and std are recomputed on every call rather than fit once and reused, so single-row inputs get NaN std (all numeric features NaN) and batches are scaled with their own statistics, shifting predictions between training and inference.
Zero-std (constant) columns produce 0/0 = NaN, which would make LogisticRegression.fit fail with 'Input contains NaN'; depends on the data, as no constant column was seen currently.
